mapper.sql: id, effect_code, effect_name, category, mode, tags, tier, description, cover_url, cover_base64, source_html, price, status, create_time, update_time, publish_time, offline_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_effect WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM biz_effect WHERE effect_code = #{effectCode} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_effect (effect_code, effect_name, category, mode, tags, tier, description, cover_url, cover_base64, source_html, price, status, publish_time, offline_time, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{effectCode}, #{effectName}, #{category}, #{mode}, #{tags}, #{tier}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{coverBase64}, #{sourceHtml}, #{price}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_effect WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT e.*, u.email AS publisher_email FROM biz_effect e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.create_by WHERE e.is_deleted=0 AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.effect_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.effect_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY e.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_effect SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW(), publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status}=1 THEN NOW() ELSE publish_time END, offline_time = CASE WHEN #{status}=0 THEN NOW() ELSE offline_time END WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE biz_effect SET is_deleted=1, status=0, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_effect WHERE is_deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_effect WHERE is_deleted=0 AND category=#{category}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_effect WHERE is_deleted=0 AND LOWER(COALESCE(category,'')) <> 'ar'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_effect WHERE is_deleted=0 AND status=#{status}
